verdict.rationale: The docs show a Pay > Make a Payment > Domestic flow that can be started on demand. That suggests ad-hoc payments outside the regular schedule, but the only documented use is recording taxable fringe benefits provided outside Justworks. Separately, docs-28 covers adjustments for payments already made. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of running off-cycle payroll for bonuses, corrections, or final/termination pay; tax handling for off-cycle runs; scheduling and approval details; independent or hands-on corroboration.
